en: Colorized postcard showing an outdoor monument in a landscaped setting. In the foreground stands a bronze statue of a man in hunting attire with a rifle and a dog at his side, mounted on a stone pedestal. Behind is a curved white stone structure with relief portraits and a flower bed at its base, framed by balustrades and evergreen trees under a blue sky. The printed captions at the top read "Bad Elster." on the left and "König Friedrich-August-Standbild." on the right.
